title: Improving Lives and Building Resilience in Vanuatu
limitations: Reported construction and access outputs, not an independent causal or climate-attribution study.

title: Strengthening resilience of the Vanuatu energy sector against climate-induced disasters
methodology: Project diagnosis and proposed institutional/technical work.
limitations: Design commitments and intended benefits are not verified outcomes.

title: Impact of Climate Change on Tropical Cyclones Over Vanuatu: A Case for Informing Disaster Planning and Adaptation Strategies
organization: Krishneel K. Sharma, Savin S. Chand and Soubhik Biswas, Federation University
temporal_coverage: Observed cyclone tracks 1971–2021; CMIP5 future-climate comparisons 2071–2100 versus 1971–2000 under RCP8.5.
methodology: Analyzes SPEArTC cyclone tracks and calibrated CMIP5 simulations using a 500-km buffer for provincial estimates.
limitations: Province-level cyclone proximity is not a direct-landfall count. Future projections use CMIP5 RCP8.5 and model-dependent estimates.

title: As the water flows – remote communities in Vanuatu creating pathways to climate resilience
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Pacific Office
temporal_coverage: Community consultations, project design and reported implementation status through March 2025.
methodology: UNDP project case account drawing on statements from Vanuatu government officials and community participants.
limitations: Not an independent impact evaluation; the project was not yet reported as delivering operating household water service.

title: National Policy on Climate Change and Disaster-Induced Displacement
organization: Government of Vanuatu, National Advisory Board on Climate Change and Disaster Risk Reduction
temporal_coverage: National displacement policy and conditions described in the 2018 document, including 2018 relocation activity.
methodology: National policy framework informed by stakeholder consultations and inter-agency planning.
limitations: Policy describes risks and intended safeguards, not a current implementation review; pathway statements are conditional and multi-causal.

title: Ministry of Climate Change Annual Report 2024
organization: Government of Vanuatu, Ministry of Climate Change
temporal_coverage: Ministry activities, project progress and constraints reported for calendar year 2024, mostly as of 31 December 2024.
methodology: Government ministry annual administrative and project-progress reporting.
limitations: Self-reported progress; several items are procurement, plans or targets rather than independently verified service outcomes.

title: Climate-related disasters and temperature extremes are not associated with conflict risk in Pacific Island countries
organization: Tobias Ide, Ore Koren and Luke Derrick, Environment and Security
temporal_coverage: Geocoded social-conflict and climate analysis for 2012–2020 in three Pacific Island countries.
methodology: Peer-reviewed panel analysis uses 0.5-degree grid-cell-year units, geocoded social conflict events and climate-disaster data.
limitations: Results are pooled across three countries; the study cannot test proposed mediating pathways and does not cover all precipitation or slow-onset effects.
